mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of bringing it home to the functionaries of government that judges are not to be taken for a ride."
The approach of Justice Jinadu is a way of bringing it home to the functionaries of government that judges are not to be taken for a ride.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important instrument of change in any society."
Education is the most important instrument of change in any society.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opium of the people, we need not look too far to know why this is easily possible especially in countries where the literacy level is low."
Once we agree that religion is the opium of the people, we need not look too far to know why this is easily possible especially in countries where the literacy level is low.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act and practice of ending the life of an individual suffering from a terminal illness or an incurable condition, as by lethal injection or the suspension of extraordinary Medical treatment."

Euthanasia is the act and practice of ending the life of an individual suffering from a terminal illness or an incurable condition, as by lethal injection or the suspension of extraordinary Medical treatment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a constitutional concept which no other law can invalidate."
The right to life is a constitutional concept which no other law can invalidate.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continental organization for the protection and promotion of human rights more desirable than in Africa which has experienced some of the worst abuses of human rights."
perhaps nowhere else is a continental organization for the protection and promotion of human rights more desirable than in Africa which has experienced some of the worst abuses of human rights.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a question of morality and not of Criminal Law."
Euthanasia similarly is a question of morality and not of Criminal Law.
fib: ______ is a means to an end; it refers to the regularity of political life within a state by means of a constitution.
Constitutionalism is a means to an end; it refers to the regularity of political life within a state by means of a constitution.
______ is a denial of right of self determination and itself was antithesis of human rights and freedoms.
Colonialism is a denial of right of self determination and itself was antithesis of human rights and freedoms.
______ is an original law of the people.
The Constitution is an original law of the people.
______ are the same as First Generation Rights, Justiciable rights, or legal rights.
The Civil and Political Rights are the same as First Generation Rights, Justiciable rights, or legal rights.
______ is the ultimate brutal act in dealing with students protest.
Killing is the ultimate brutal act in dealing with students protest.
______ is an area of Law which deals with the study of Human Rights and authorities of the state and the organization of the state.
Human Rights Law is an area of Law which deals with the study of Human Rights and authorities of the state and the organization of the state.
